page: OVHcloud a10-45 is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance engineered for compute-heavy parallel workloads and AI inference. Powered by the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9554 processor, the instance allocates 30 dedicated physical cores without simultaneous multithreading at an operational frequency of 3.3 GHz. The compute cluster is paired with a dedicated single NVIDIA A10 Ampere GPU featuring 24 GB of GDDR6 VRAM. System memory is sized at 42.0 GB, yielding a compact ratio of 1.4 GB per core, while local persistent storage is supplied via a 400 GB SSD. Baseline networking bandwidth is configured at 8 Gbps over a KVM hypervisor foundation.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong computational efficiency driven by the dedicated EPYC cores and advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 VNNI and BF16 support. In stress-ng testing, single-core execution reached top-tier standing with a score of 3,108.08, while multi-core stress testing yielded 93,542.95, placing it within the upper 25% of measured systems. Geekbench single-core throughput achieved 2,029.0 points, alongside high scores in compiler execution tests with Clang (43,343.0). Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression delivered 389.24 GB/sec, reflecting strong multi-core processing bandwidth.

The instance exhibits a distinct hardware asymmetry: high core count and specialized graphics compute balanced against a modest 42.0 GB memory capacity. Memory throughput is strong for smaller cache-resident operations (4,152.61 GB/sec in 16 KB read tests), but larger block memory bandwidth remains in the middle 50% percentile (103.8 GB/sec read, 46.73 GB/sec write). Consequently, the configuration is cost-effective for graphics tasks and parallelized processing that do not require massive system memory pools.

OVHcloud a10-45 is well suited for machine learning inference, real-time video encoding, ray tracing pipelines, graphics virtualization, and parallel batch data processing. It is less optimal for massive in-memory databases or large-scale model pre-training that demand vast host RAM or multi-GPU interconnects.
description: OVHcloud a10-45 is a GPU-accelerated cloud server featuring 30 dedicated physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9554 processor at 3.3 GHz and an NVIDIA A10 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. Operating on a KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 architecture, the server provides 42.0 GB of system RAM, a 400 GB local SSD, and 8 Gbps baseline network throughput. In synthetic benchmarks, the instance achieves top-decile stress-ng single-core performance (3,108.08) and top-quartile multi-core marks (93,542.95), supplemented by hardware acceleration for AVX-512 vector formats. The ratio of 1.4 GB RAM per core indicates an architecture optimized for compute and accelerator density rather than large in-memory data sets. It provides a balanced platform for machine learning inference, rendering, visual computing pipelines, and software compilation tasks requiring GPU acceleration.
